tagline: Fuse every specialist's signal into one score per asset.
problem: Each specialist finds something real — KEV, EOL, weak crypto, an attack path, no owner — but a team can't work fifteen lists. The asset that appears on five of them matters more than any single finding, and no single score shows that.
does: Exposure Score gives every asset one 0–100 Exposure Score built from 16 signals — exploitability (KEV and EPSS), Tenable AES and VPR, ACR, attack paths, identity, compliance, web-app findings, EOL, internet exposure, AI risk, weak or expiring crypto, SLA aging, finding volume, ownership and ATT&CK — then shows what to act on now, the worst asset from each specialist, and where their signals converge.

glance.caption: Exposure Score's At a glance on a 128-asset lab: every asset scored (1 high, 28 elevated, 99 low), 1 to act on now at 60 or more; 7 of 11 crown jewels carry a KEV, 4 run EOL software and 7 are blind; 71 assets have no owner.

capabilities: weights sum to 100, so a score reads as the share of the most danger one asset can carry; dispositions discount it, and Scan Health's coverage flags how far to trust it.
drag any weight to re-rank the estate to what matters to you; each weighting is cached separately.
Your assets, or the whole estate

score one tag's assets — an owner, a business tier, an environment — and every count, band, act-now set and leaderboard re-builds over just them, with each asset's score unchanged. Tag views keep their own cache, so you switch between a tag and the whole estate without rebuilding either.
the assets over 80, 60 or 40 today, with one-click hand-offs: tag Priority, tag owners (Ownership), email owners (Notify & Reports), raise ACR (Criticality Calibration) or add to the Contract.
the top asset each specialist's signal points at — and the assets where several converge.
every asset's score broken down by factor, and how widespread each signal is across the estate.
Priority : P1 to P4 on the act-now set, recomputed on the server from navi.db — not taken from the browser.
how: Direct signals (KEV, EPSS, VPR, ACR, EOL, certificates, compliance, WAS, SLA aging) come straight from your local navi.db; the rest are read from the tags other specialists write. Per-asset aggregation runs inside the database, so it holds up on very large estates. Results are cached per navi.db and weighting, and rebuilt in the background.
who: VM leads who need one ranked list, and executives who want to know which assets carry the most danger — and why.
better: Exposure Score is the Ensemble's convergence point: Laelaps, Fenrir, Identity Inventory, Compliance Overview, Arachne, Charon, Pythia, Certania, Heimdall, SLA Tracker, Ownership and ATT&CK Mapping all feed it. Ensemble Report's crown-jewel and score cards open its evidence, Asset Dossier shows any asset's score and rank, and Automation can tag the top of the list P1.
different: the same ordering at 100 assets or a million.
every point traced to the specialist and finding behind it.
low scan coverage lowers confidence instead of hiding risk.
cta: Ask Exposure Score which assets have earned the reckoning — and act on those first.
